What the app sends to your server. Parameters: a list of names and values. JSON body: one JSON text you write yourself. Both can contain webhook fields such as [msg] for the formatted message and [from] for the sender, and message data such as {{FROM}}. Insert data adds one at the cursor; Preview shows the request with sample data and sends nothing.

Lets your server check that a request really comes from this app. With a secret filled in, the app adds a timestamp and a signature (sign) to every request. Leave it empty if your server does not check signatures.

Use this when your server answers with a fixed text on success, for example ok. If that text is missing from the answer, the delivery is logged as Failed. Leave it empty to accept every answer that is not an error. A failed check does not start a new attempt; you can resend from the log.
Extra HTTP headers sent with every request. Most servers need one only for a login token. Leave this empty if your server needs none.
